messages:
rafa: Heads-up: sudden drizzle turned into a nasty spritz on the Embarcadero. Saw a scooter do a graceful slide into some puddles. Anyone delayed?

sophie: ugh my scooter seat is soaked. Ferry app says hold times +15.

carlos: BART seems OK but the 3/3R shuttle is running late because of slow boarding at Embarcadero.

mina: got a pic of the puddle at Mission & 2nd if anyone wants to laugh/cry: https://imgur.com/example (tiny surfboard joke)

tom: lol that lookslike a minipond. If anyone needs an emergency towel I have three in the office kitchen.

rafa: @tom legend. also ops-bot posted: possible low-tide splash advisory for piers 7-14.

ops-bot: SYSTEM: Travel advisory posted. Expect minor flooding on waterfront paths. See internal status page: https://status.redwood.example/travel/advisories/1959

janet: For people commuting: recommend swapping to BART, or give yourself an extra 30m. Also parking garage level 2 has a small leak near the EV chargers.

sophie: quick poll: who wants a ride from SoMa? react :car: for yes, :bus: for switching to transit, :home: for staying remote.

carlos: :car: I can take 2. ETA 20m from Potrero.

mina: :bus: My bike is half-dry and I refuse soggy socks.

tom: :home: working from the dry den today. Coffee if anyone swings by before 10.

rafa: PS if you lock your bike on the pier, clip a small bag over the saddle. Salt spray is a mood killer for leather saddles.

janet: Also shoutout to @carlos who stopped to help a cyclist change a flat earlier. :clap: Good human energy.

carlos: was nothing, just an allen key and some duct tape.

mina: OK I27m switching to BART. Keep updates coming, stay dry y'all.
